description: Preserve the accepted R05 account and record the author's exact documentary acceptance in a separate attributable record.
Distinguish author-reported access, storage, administrative identifier use and authentication from verified documentary context and unresolved security evidence.

Retain the directly stored analytical linkage key and non-anonymity distinction, personal Dropbox authorization gap, former coordinators' unknown copies, unknown retention/encryption and absent handover arrangement.

Leave the formal R05 response, D1_rights, R04 restricted-data route and all institutional, security, deletion, access, execution and release gates unchanged.

Validate 41 content/status checks and 17 negative controls; retain the failed validation command and its quoting recovery. Confirm preservation of 1,243 tracked files, six prior R03/R04 files and 23,281 private audit files.
No participant inspection, contacts, live security checks, fitting, source edits, commit, push, synchronization, submission or release.
